items.title: August Laurent Interview, 1960-03-21
items.q: We used to sit down together at one of his lady friends' house. In the backyard, two clarinets, Pico on one and me on one, and played together.

ctx.x: What part of town were you born in? Were you born right here in the city of New Orleans?

In the 7th Ward. That's why I moved back down here. I'm born right there. Prairie and La Perouse. You heard Big Iloy? Oh yes you heard man. I was living in the middle of the block. Big Iloy was living at that corner. Pico was living around the corner. Lorenzo Teo was living two blocks from me. Papa Teo was living a block and a half this way from me. I was right in them.

I don't like to bother you with all those details but if we can figure out where some of those fellas lived. Like Big I. Now what corner was that on about? Which street? Like Big Iloy. Just which street?
